audience: gym owners and front-desk staff who manage members, classes and check-ins in PushPress

useCases.title: Count member check-ins for a period
useCases.text: Count the check-ins in a date range, optionally for one customer. List the class check-ins of that range to see who attended.

useCases.title: Review the class schedule and bookings
useCases.text: List the scheduled classes from a start date, with coach, location and times. Open a class and list its reservations.

useCases.title: Look up a member and the plans they joined
useCases.text: Find a customer by email, then read the contact details and membership. List the enrollments of that customer to see their plans.

useCases.title: Add a new member
useCases.text: Search for the email address first, then create the customer with an email address and an optional name and phone number.
